preflight_steps: Read the current ASC3ND Instagram profile.
Inspect the latest twelve Feed items.
Detect pinned posts, manual posts, archived posts, and deletions.
Compare current visible order against the approved grid manifest.
Generate or record a post-publication grid preview.
Confirm asset ID, row, column, visual family, date, and caption.
Obtain human approval before scheduling or publishing.
post_publish_verification: Confirm the intended post is live.
Confirm the correct cover is visible.
Confirm there is no duplicate or accidental post.
Record the live URL and verification timestamp.
event_day_rule: Use Stories and Reels for event-day coverage. Do not add an unplanned Feed tile that disrupts the four-row system.
